name: contract-capability-rows
goal: Allow cases for declared prop and error capability changes while rejecting unexplained count growth

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: f4b5cdd556 removed admission for newly declared props and errors and added conflicting guidance; prior comparison accepted them.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing compare case incorrectly required rejection of both capability changes. Strengthen it across visual and API matrices, retain rejection for unrelated growth, and check generated guidance in the existing loop cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Capture at 21d0c0b0e5 fails the existing comparison case because an API row for a newly declared prop is refused; generated guidance also rejects the requested rule.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Restore admission for rows naming newly declared props or errors, retain duplicate and unrelated-row rejection, and make the existing generated-guidance cases check the same rule.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Rows that name newly declared props or errors are admitted; duplicate and unrelated rows remain rejected. The same policy now drives project, skill, generated, and agent guidance.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged ten cases pass at 7bdb5da65e after the same cases failed at 21d0c0b0e5; both captures use the same sanitized environment.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated mutant f35edbf6ed rejects a newly declared prop and fails the unchanged case (capture ba1682976d3e); restored tree 550a34e6e3 passes the same ten cases (capture ced64983c44a).

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
